query: Hyderabad Kolkata Ola Uber cab fare base fare per km rupees 2026
snippet: Ola in Hyderabad: base fare Rs 80-100 for first 4-5km, Ola Mini Rs 8-11/km, Ola Prime Sedan Rs 12-15/km, Ola Prime SUV Rs 16-22/km, time charge ~Rs 1/min. Under Motor Vehicles Aggregator Guidelines (MVAG) 2025, surge is capped at 2x base fare during peak hours. Cancellation penalty 10% of fare capped at Rs 100.
